intro: Enter a fast-paced retro shooter filled with pixel-art action, dangerous enemies and relentless gunfire. Aim carefully, survive each encounter and clear your path through the battlefield.
description:
Step into the chaotic world of Rasterfire, a fast-paced top-down shooter inspired by the golden age of arcade action.

Fight your way through dangerous environments filled with hostile enemies, incoming projectiles and deadly obstacles. Keep moving, aim carefully and use your limited space to avoid attacks while returning fire. Every encounter tests your reactions, positioning and ability to survive under pressure.

The battlefield is viewed from above and presented in a distinctive retro pixel-art style, enhanced by CRT scanlines, vivid effects and an energetic arcade atmosphere. Enemies can attack from multiple directions, so staying alert is just as important as having a quick trigger finger.

Clear each area, survive increasingly intense battles and push forward through waves of opposition. Whether you are chasing a higher score or simply trying to reach the end, every round offers a compact dose of old-school shooting action.

Features:

Fast-paced top-down shooting gameplay
Retro pixel-art graphics with CRT-inspired effects
Multiple enemy types and dangerous attack patterns
Responsive controls designed for quick arcade action
Increasingly intense combat encounters
A dark, energetic soundtrack and classic shooter atmosphere

Load your weapon, enter the crosshairs and see how long you can survive in Rasterfire.
